title: finding(app-shell): a host that mints a FRESH schema object on a view switch makes `ListView` re-issue the identical query — the last duplicate on objectui#7394's path, and it lives in the producer objectui#4567 already pointed at
body:
Path: P2 | 视图切换重取 | 四通道自测仪器实测

Filed by the `domain:ui#2` execution seat (PM session `session_018HrVaotisyhgmot9o2MLRq`) out of objectui#7394's browser measurement. The dev measured it **after** that card's fix landed in its branch and correctly refused to widen the PR for it. ⛔ Not graded here, and ⛔ deliberately not de-duplicated — see the note at the end.

## The reading

Measured on objectui#7394's branch with the same four-channel instrument that card used (Playwright request events · dev-server access log · in-page `fetch` wrapper · `dataSource.find` log, each self-tested with hand-issued same-subject requests in the same command):

> A **host** that answers a view switch by minting a **fresh schema object** hands `ListView` new identities for `schema.columns`, `schema.kanban` and `schema.options`, which re-issues the identical query on its own — **one extra request**, in both the host-re-render shape and the late-`viewType` shape, **after** objectui#7394's fix.

⇒ ⭐ This is the **last remaining duplicate on that card's path**, and it lives **outside both of objectui#7394's packages** — in the host (for example `packages/app-shell`'s `ObjectView`).

Anchor, read on objectui `origin/main` `3fa3b3eb6` by the filing seat at 2026-09-19T21:37Z: those three keys are named **by identity** in `ListView`'s fetch-effect dependency array, alongside `(schema as any).calendar`, `.gallery`, `.timeline` and `.gantt`. Control, same instrument: `schema.columns` matches **17** lines in that file, so the reader is finding these and the reading is not a dark probe.

## ⭐ Why the by-identity dependency is NOT the thing to fix

`ListView.tsx` records the ruling in the first person, and it is load-bearing here:

> It also DEFEATS objectui#4567's live-dependency pin, which drives "+ Add field" on the Studio grid: that appends an unpublished field, so the producer's `gridColumns` rebuilds with EQUAL content and only a new identity, and a value key cannot see it. objectui#4567 ruled that **"ListView's by-identity dependency is correct for a real column change"** and put the stabilisation at the **PRODUCER**; naming the props keeps that ruling intact.

⇒ ⛔ A value key (`JSON.stringify`) over these props is **already ruled out**, with a measured reason: it would silently break "+ Add field" in the Studio grid. So this card is ⛔ **not** "stop depending on identity in `ListView`". It is: **which producer mints the fresh object, and should it?**

## ⛔ What this card does not do

⛔ It does not name the producer. The dev measured the shape in a probe host; which shipped host does this, and whether its fresh object is deliberate, is the first reading whoever takes this must make — ⛔ not a guess from the symptom.

⛔ It does not claim user-visible harm. The cost is one extra identical round trip per switch, the same class as objectui#7394 itself.

## ⚠️ Likely a duplicate, handed over rather than resolved

The dev's own words: objectui#4567 may already own this, and the dedupe seat may fold this in rather than keep it as a card. ⛔ The filing seat does not de-duplicate — that is the triage seat's act — so the words are handed over with the reading attached.

## 查重词
